description: Labelled queries over the supplied case archive. Relevance labels are read off the files themselves: case_4, case_6 and case_8 each state in their own text that they have no connection to the theft, and case_7 describes a post-hoc extortion attempt rather than the theft or the laundering. They are listed as distractors for exactly the questions whose vocabulary they share.

queries.question: How did the hacker launder the stolen funds?
How did the attacker first gain access?
What evidence points to where the money ended up?
Was the exchange targeted before the theft itself?
Did the attacker try to extort the exchange after the theft?
What techniques were used to obscure the trail?
